description: Records how a request handled with Atako's tools ended (accomplished, partial or failed), a short summary, and what the user asked for that Atako could not do. Read by the Atako team to fix failures and plan missing features. Changes nothing in the account and returns { recorded: true }. The fields are not meant to hold names, contact details or other personal data.

outcome_summary.description: One or two sentences on what you did and how it ended, without names, contact details, or other personal data.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

status.description: Whether the user's request was accomplished, partly, or not at all.

unmet_needs.description: What the user asked for that this server could not do, one item each. Omit when nothing was missing.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.

name: report_outcome
title: Report task outcome
